<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518913707_theRebbe_562" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518913707_theRebbe_562__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>To build Malchus, one must draw from a place beyond the existence of worlds and souls, raising the question of how souls can reach that level.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And based on this,</t>
    <t s="1">in order to effect that there be a building of Malchus, one must draw from a place where there is no</t>
    <t s="2">(not only the existence of the worlds,</t>
    <t s="3">but where there is no)</t>
    <t s="4">also the existence of souls.</t>
    <t s="5">And one must understand,</t>
    <t s="6">how is it possible that souls, through their service, will reach a place that is above their existence.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The explanation is that the absence of place for souls during the removal of Malchus relates to their existence, while the request "Make Me King" reflects the inner self-nullification of the soul's essence rooted in Atzmus.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And the point of the explanation in this,</t>
    <t s="1">is that this, that at the time of the removal of Malchus</t>
    <t s="2">(in the levels above Malchus)</t>
    <t s="3">there is seemingly no place for souls and their service</t>
    <t s="4">(for souls and Malchus are one matter),</t>
    <t s="5">is regarding the existence of souls,</t>
    <t s="6">and the matter of "Make Me King"</t>
    <t s="7">(that Yisrael request and beseech the Holy One, blessed be He, that He be King)</t>
    <t s="8">is the inner self-nullification from the aspect of the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="9">which is rooted in the Awtsmoos.</t>
    <t s="10">And when the essence of the soul is revealed, it draws down the Awtsmoos.</t>
    <t s="11">And through this, the building of Malchus is also effected.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The building of Malchus through drawing down the Awtsmoos is explained by the concept that Yisrael arose in Essential Thought, which is one with the Thinker, and they are above the thought of creation, as the consultation about creation was with them.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation of the matter of the building of Malchus that is effected through the drawing down of the Awtsmoos, which is through the revelation of the essence of the soul,</t>
    <t s="2">one may say,</t>
    <t s="3">based on what is explained in many places</t>
    <t s="4">regarding the matter of "Yisrael arose in thought",</t>
    <t s="5">that this thought is Essential Thought.</t>
    <t s="6">For thought in general is outside the thinker</t>
    <t s="7">[And like a person who thinks about some thing,</t>
    <t s="8">the thought about the thing is below the person himself,</t>
    <t s="9">and consequently it is like outside of him],</t>
    <t s="10">but the thought of Yisrael is one with the Thinker Himself.</t>
    <t s="11">And this is "Whom did He consult? The souls of the righteous"</t>
    <t s="12">(and "Your people are all righteous"),</t>
    <t s="13">that the consultation of "Whom did He consult" was not only about the creation of the worlds</t>
    <t s="14">(whether to create worlds or not to create),</t>
    <t s="15">but also about the thought of the coming into being of the worlds</t>
    <t s="16">(whether there would be the thought of the coming into being of the worlds or not),</t>
    <t s="17">from which it is understood,</t>
    <t s="18">that the souls of Yisrael</t>
    <t s="19">(with whom He consulted whether there would be the thought of the creation of the worlds)</t>
    <t s="20">are above this thought.</t>
    <t s="21">For the thought of the creation of the worlds,</t>
    <t s="22">even as it is in the most elevated level,</t>
    <t s="23">is analogous to a person thinking about some thing</t>
    <t s="24">(a thought to create worlds),</t>
    <t s="25">that the thought is outside of him,</t>
    <t s="26">but Yisrael arose in Essential Thought.</t>
    <t s="27">And it is explained there,</t>
    <t s="28">that the reason for this, that the consultation about the thought of the creation of the worlds was with Yisrael who arose in Essential Thought</t>
    <t s="29">(even though Essential Thought is above the thought of the creation of the worlds),</t>
    <t s="30">is,</t>
    <t s="31">because in Essential Thought there are two modes.</t>
    <t s="32">One thinks about himself,</t>
    <t s="33">and one thinks about something separate from him, and nevertheless the thought is not outside of him because he himself is the thinker.</t>
    <t s="34">And this that Yisrael arose in thought is the second mode in Essential Thought,</t>
    <t s="35">that the Awtsmoos thinks, so to speak, about something else</t>
    <t s="36">[And this is "You are children to Hashem your G-d",</t>
    <t s="37">for since the root of the souls is in Essential Thought,</t>
    <t s="38">that the Awtsmoos thinks, so to speak, about something else,</t>
    <t s="39">therefore,</t>
    <t s="40">even after they come into a drawing down, they are like children,</t>
    <t s="41">for in a child</t>
    <t s="42">(analogous to)</t>
    <t s="43">the two aforementioned matters.</t>
    <t s="44">The child is separate from the father, and nevertheless there is within him from the father's very essence].</t>
    <t s="45">And therefore the consultation about the thought of the worlds was with Yisrael.</t>
    <t s="46">For the purpose of the creation of the world</t>
    <t s="47">[that the lower ones be a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He]</t>
    <t s="48">is completed through the souls.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
